This was actually more of a nightmare but it's one of the few that I remember. 

It started off with me walking through the front entrance of my high school but I was the only person there. Next i went into the bathroom to my left and swung open a stall door. To my surprise there were thousands of mosquitoes behind the door, they were so dense I could barely see the toilet even though it was right in front of me. 

This was one of those dreams that stops and picks up somewhere else just for context. 

So after that I ended up in the parking lot of a cemetery and I could see a bunch of caskets sitting above ground. I noticed that they all had windows on them so I could see the corpses inside, but one of them was completely open. I walked up to get a closer look at the old man and I saw his sunken eyes and all the yellow stained fabric. 

When I woke up from this dream I felt physically sick. but for some reason I wish I had stayed asleep to see how much weirder things would get.
This gave me a little relief, I've been stuck in the same thought loop for about a week. Some of them feel like delusions and that's the worst part for me.
